Earlier bookings archive

All people in the current custody mirror, newest first, with the same search and filters as the homepage

The homepage shows a small recent-booking preview. This archive lists the complete current custody roster by booking month, searchable in one place. It is not a historical archive of released people.

Arrest is not conviction. Independent public-records mirror. No paid removals.

Everyone listed here is legally presumed innocent unless and until proven guilty in a court of law. The charges shown are accusations only and may be reduced, dismissed, or result in acquittal.

Independent, non-governmental project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by the Hamilton County Sheriff's Office, Hamilton County, or any other government entity.

This site republishes current public inmate-roster facts for civic, journalistic, and accountability use. It does not furnish consumer reports and is not offered as a consumer reporting agency as those terms are defined in 15 U.S.C. 1681a(d) and 1681a(f). Do not use this site, or any data obtained from it, as a factor in determining a person's eligibility for credit, insurance, employment, housing, tenant screening, or any other purpose described in 15 U.S.C. 1681b. FCRA coverage is determined by those statutory definitions, not by this notice.

The source records are kept by a public office. A requester's right to inspect and copy those records from the public office is governed by R.C. 149.43. That statute imposes duties on the public office or person responsible for public records. It does not license, restrict, or otherwise govern reuse of disclosed public-record facts by this independent project.
